# Creative Brief & Site Plan — Acme Corp

## Project Overview

Acme Corp is a technology company seeking a full website redesign to improve conversions and modernize their brand presence. The project targets small business owners aged 30-55.

----------

## Goals & Objectives

- Redesign website with clean, minimal aesthetic
- Improve conversion rates through strong CTAs
- Modernize brand presence online
- Appeal to target demographic of small business owners

----------

## Target Audience

- **Primary:** Small business owners, age 30-55
- Tech-savvy but time-constrained
- Looking for reliable solutions

----------

## Scope of Work

### Design
- Homepage redesign
- Interior page templates
- Mobile-responsive layouts

### Development
- Front-end build
- CMS integration
- Contact form and lead capture

----------

## Timeline & Budget

- **Timeline:** 3 months
- **Budget:** $15,000–$25,000

----------

## Checklist

[x] Brand guidelines received
[ ] Content audit complete
[ ] Wireframes approved
[ ] Design mockups approved
[ ] Development complete
[ ] QA testing complete
[ ] Launch
